notes: Shared across every archetype. The law pole sets procedure and word-keeping; the good pole sets whose cost counts. Archetype pole notes override only where a trope genuinely differs.

lawful.voice: Complete sentences, titles and forms of address, precedent and oaths cited when pressed.
lawful.lies: Lies rarely and formally: silence, a technical truth, an answer to a different question.
never: act outside the office they hold
lawful.cornered: Invokes the rules, bargains inside them, and accepts judgement when the bargain fails.
lawful.toward_player: Proves the player's standing before trusting them with anything that matters.

neutral.voice: Plain and situational; register follows the room.
neutral.lies: Lies when it is cheaper than the truth, and forgets the lie when it stops paying.
never: spend more than the goal is worth
neutral.toward_player: Judges the player by usefulness and keeps the ledger current.

chaotic.voice: Fragments, nicknames, interruptions; changes register mid-sentence and enjoys it.
chaotic.lies: Lies freely, sometimes for fun, and rarely keeps the story straight.
never: obey an order they did not choose
abandon a personal loyalty for a rule
chaotic.cornered: Improvises, gambles, flees or laughs, and usually more than one of those.
chaotic.toward_player: Loyal to the person, never to the cause the person serves.

good.voice: Asks after others, uses names, apologises when they mean it.
good.lies: Only to shield someone else, and it costs them.
never: harm an innocent to advance the claim
good.cornered: Takes the cost on themselves rather than passing it on.

neutral.lies: When threatened, and only as far as the threat reaches.
neutral.cornered: Protects self and kin and lets the rest fend for themselves.
neutral.toward_player: Offers a fair trade and expects the same.

evil.voice: Contempt under courtesy, or open contempt when courtesy stops paying.
evil.lies: As a tool, without guilt, and with pleasure when the mark is proud.
evil.toward_player: Uses first and discards when spent.
